revision_notes: 0.2: S-H1 corrected (coverage ends before period end, so complete=false and the state at period end is UNKNOWN).
0.2: S-C2 second legacy row moved to 10:00:01Z so the two rows have different legacy natural keys (asset + event type + timestamp) and can both exist as stored rows.
0.2: READY_FOR_CORE renamed CONTRACT_SHAPE_ONLY_REPO_UNVERIFIED (the repository was never inspected).
0.2: added S-P1, S-P2, S-Q1, S-Q2, S-R, S-T1, S-T2 (missing/invalid timezone, offset-less timestamp, explicit offset, truncation, DST missing and repeated local midnight).
0.2: ranking metric fixed as outages_started_in_period (team confirmation); RANKING_METRIC_PROPOSED dependency removed. The ADR text still lists it as Proposed and should be updated separately.

0.3: repository inspected (docs/ADR_GOLDEN_FIXTURES_RESOLUTION.md). Migration 014 added door_opened/access_granted, so CATALOGUE_NO_DOOR_OPENED / CATALOGUE_NO_ACCESS_GRANTED are resolved and the door mappings now name the catalogue types. DOOR_FORCED_OPEN maps to door_forced and is never counted as a normal opening (see expectations S-E1/S-E2).

0.3: READY_FOR_CORE and CONTRACT_SHAPE_ONLY_REPO_UNVERIFIED replaced by PROTOTYPE_REPLAY_VERIFIED / NEEDS_DECISION / BLOCKED_*. PROTOTYPE_REPLAY_VERIFIED is test readiness on synthetic data only, NOT real vendor connector readiness (none exists in the repository).
fixture_meta.repository_inspection_note: 0.3: the repository was inspected statically (code, migrations 003-014, contract, tests). The unit tests replay these fixtures; the PostgreSQL integration tests were NOT executed in the environment that produced 0.3. Fixture statuses describe prototype/test readiness only.

status_values.PROTOTYPE_REPLAY_VERIFIED: The scenario is replayed by unit tests against the implemented tool on synthetic data with an injected coverage provider and matches this oracle. NOT a claim that a real vendor connector, vendor-to-catalogue mapping, retrieval-completion reporting or production CoverageProvider exists: none does (only connectors/reference_simulator).
status_values.NEEDS_DECISION: Fixture and implementation differ on a point the approved rules do not settle; see docs/ADR_GOLDEN_FIXTURES_RESOLUTION.md.
status_values.CONTRACT_SHAPE_ONLY_REPO_UNVERIFIED: Ingestion records use existing catalogue types and the contract 1.0 shape as stated in the brief, but the repository was not inspected: asset/system compatibility is assumed from event names and runnability in the current project is NOT established.
status_values.BLOCKED_BY_TOOL_CONTRACT: Needs a tool parameter or result rule that is not defined in the tool signatures or the ADR.
status_values.BLOCKED_BY_CATALOGUE: Needs an event type that does not exist in the Core catalogue (unused since migration 014; only unlock_command is still absent).
status_values.BLOCKED_BY_SCHEMA: Needs a field/storage path that contract 1.0 or the database does not have.
status_values.BLOCKED_BY_CONNECTOR: Needs connector-reported retrieval completion or coverage that is not defined today.
status_values.NEEDS_REPO_VERIFICATION: Whether the current repository behaves as the scenario requires could not be established.

dependency_codes.CONTRACT_NO_PHYSICAL_OPEN_CONFIRMATION: Contract 1.0 cannot express that a door_forced event confirms physical opening (ADR open question b).
dependency_codes.CONTRACT_NO_CORRELATION_FIELD: Contract 1.0 has no correlation identifier; fixture-only attributes are used (ADR open question b).
dependency_codes.EVENT_DEDUP_ENFORCEMENT_UNVERIFIED: RESOLVED statically: unique index uq_event_source_event_id (migration 006) enforces (source_id, source_event_id) when both are non-null; legacy rows use uq_event_legacy_natural_key (migration 007). Not re-executed against PostgreSQL here.
dependency_codes.LEGACY_ROW_IDENTITY_HANDLING_UNVERIFIED: How analytics reads legacy rows with NULL source_event_id (and their source attribution) is unverified (ADR open question f).
dependency_codes.CONTRACT_NO_TIMESTAMP_QUALITY_OR_QUARANT: No timestamp_quality field or quarantine path exists; observed_at is required and probably NOT NULL (ADR D-11, open question f).
dependency_codes.CONNECTOR_NO_COMPLETION_STATUS: No connector retrieval-completion status is defined or stored (ADR D-12, open question g).
dependency_codes.LIVENESS_GAP_READING_UNVERIFIED: Whether analytics reads existing freshness/liveness/data-gap records and their exact value shapes is unverified.
dependency_codes.RESULT_STATUS_ENUM_PROPOSED: COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED/CANNOT_COMPUTE is only Proposed in the ADR (open question g).
dependency_codes.LOOKBACK_HORIZON_OPEN_QUESTION_D: Look-back horizon is an open question; fixture assumes the last reliable earlier transition is readable.
dependency_codes.TIMEZONE_COLUMN_BEHAVIOUR_UNVERIFIED: Whether a building can actually hold a NULL or an invalid timezone value (versus validation at write time) is unverified; if not reachable through data, the case must be tested at unit level.
dependency_codes.VALIDATION_ERROR_SHAPE_UNDEFINED: The API error shape and error codes for rejected input are not defined; the codes in the fixtures are labels.
dependency_codes.RESULT_LIMIT_PARAMETER_UNDEFINED: Neither tool signature has a result limit; max_rows is a fixture-only parameter used only to exercise truncated=true.
dependency_codes.TOTAL_ROWS_SEMANTICS_ASSUMED: Assumed: total_rows is the number of rows before truncation. The ADR does not define it.
dependency_codes.ROW_EMISSION_RULE_ASSUMED: Fixtures assume a row is emitted only for an asset/door that has at least one eligible event; the ADR does not say.
dependency_codes.FIXTURE_TIMEZONE_RULES_UNVERIFIED_AGAINS: Offsets and transition dates were derived by hand from the published rules and must be checked against tzdata by a human reviewer.
dependency_codes.ASSET_SYSTEM_COMPATIBILITY_UNVERIFIED: Event-type/system-type compatibility was assumed from names.

global_assumptions: Africa/Cairo is used as a fixture timezone for buildings BLD-ALPHA and BLD-BRAVO. On 2026-11-01..2026-11-03 it is assumed to be on standard time, UTC+02:00 (Egyptian DST assumed to end on 2026-10-29). The production building timezone is unknown.
Europe/Berlin is a test-only fixture timezone (scenario S-B), not a production default.
The ADR's external_event_id is treated as the contract's source_event_id.
Result statuses and field names for expected results follow the ADR's Proposed schema and are not a decided contract.
Source coverage (pages/range fetched) cannot be recorded today; each scenario's source_coverage is a fixture assertion, so complete=true is conditional on that mechanism existing.
Request end dates are inclusive calendar dates in the building timezone (D-10); the internal interval is [start_utc, end_utc).

scenarios.explanation_batch_vs_event_identity: Batch idempotency key = (source, batch_id): it decides whether a whole batch submission is a replay (same key, different content: first write wins). Event identity = (source, source_event_id): it decides whether two event records are the same source event. Here every redelivery uses a NEW batch_id, so batch idempotency does not suppress anything; only event identity can. Event payloads are byte-identical across deliveries.

scenarios.note: Legacy rows are stored rows written by the old POST /events path, not contract 1.0 ingestion records. The legacy natural key is asset + event type + timestamp, so two rows with an identical key might not both be storable. LEG-C2-001 (10:00:00Z) and LEG-C2-002 (10:00:01Z) therefore differ by 1 second: distinct natural keys, same event type and payload. The test is that similarity must not cause a merge. The fixture row keys LEG-* are fixture-only. The source attribution of legacy rows is unknown; SRC-LEGACY-C2 is a fixture-only placeholder.

building.timezone_note: TEST-ONLY fixture timezone, not a production default. Chosen because its DST change happens at local midnight. Rules recalled by hand, not verified: DST starts on the second Sunday of March at 00:00 CST (-05:00), when clocks jump to 01:00 CDT (-04:00); 2026-03-08 is that Sunday, so local 00:00 on 2026-03-08 does not exist.

TEST-ONLY fixture timezone, not a production default. Verified against IANA tzdb 2026f and Microsoft's interim Cuba DST guidance: the scheduled November 1, 2026 fallback was canceled; Cuba remains UTC-04 through November 7, 2027. Local midnight on 2026-11-01 occurs once at 04:00Z; the next midnight is 2026-11-02T04:00:00Z, so this date-based period is 24 hours.
